title: EUDI Relying-Party Verifier Assurance Profile
claim_boundary: A conforming run shows only that a named verifier path enforced the listed technical and semantic refusal rules for a frozen transaction record. It does not establish legal compliance, certification, lawful purpose, or ENISA endorsement.

rules.requirement: The presentation input is syntactically processable.
The relying party is registered for wallet use.
A suspended or cancelled registration cannot authorize a request.
The authenticated relying-party identity matches the registered identity.
The transaction purpose is among the purposes declared for the relying party.
Requested attributes are a subset of the registered attribute set.
Every selectively disclosed value is bound to the issuer-signed object.
Holder or device binding required by the credential and transaction succeeds.
The presentation is bound to the intended verifier audience.
The presentation is bound to the verifier challenge.
The presentation falls within the declared freshness window.
Credential status is active at verification time.
The issuer is accepted by the relying party's applicable trust policy.
Attributes used in the reliance decision are a subset of the attributes approved for the transaction.
The relying party records the asserted legal basis separately from wallet-user approval.
The decision identifies the verifier version, policy version, registration identifier and a stable reason code.
